text:
Situation: Quetiapine fumarate 100 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 45 tablets (5.7 days at 7.8/day). Corvale General holds 204 tablets (24.4 days at 8.4/day). Both sites use NDC 65862049101 labeled by Aurobindo Pharma Limited, manufactured at FEI 3004021229 in India.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for FEI 3004021229 show an OAI classification from an inspection ending 2010-09-24 and a most recent VAI classification from an inspection ending 2023-07-21.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support an internal transfer without jeopardizing its operations. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 65 tablets of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from NorthStar Rx LLC (Aurobindo plant, VAI 2023-07-21) — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Accord Healthcare Inc. (Intas plant, OAI 2022-12-02) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchases from ACI Healthcare USA, Inc. or Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC because their labels name no identifiable manufacturing plant for quality assessment.
